tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /shrī dhar+m+ma swā mi bud+dha rat+na shrī bha dra s+ya bi mo k+ṣa shu bha rat+na ni dhī nā ma shrī bhū mi paṇ+ḍi te na kṛ te bi dza ha ra// ༄༅/ /chos rje sangs rgyas rin chen dpal bzang po'i rnam thar dge legs rin po che'i gter zhes bya ba dpal sa skya'i mkhas pas sbyar ba bzhugs so// saṃ skṛ ta bhā ṣa/ shrī dhar+m+ma swā mi bud+dha rat+na shrī bha dra s+ya bi mo k+ṣa shu bha rat+na ni dhi nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal chos kyi rje sangs rgyas rin chen dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa dge legs rin po che'i gter zhes bya ba/ dpal mthu stobs kyi mgon po dang gnyis su med pa'i bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen rab nyin mo'i mgon/ /thugs rje mchog tu dkar ba'i bsil zer can/ /gsang ba'i bdag po gang de'i mthu stobs kyi/ /dpal la 'gran byed rigs brgya'i mgon der 'dud/ /de lta'i yon tan dpag yas rgya mtsho'i gter/ /rnam mang skye dgu'i nyer 'tsho bla na med/ /phyogs kyi mtha' gru kun nas mdzes byed pa/ /nor 'dzin khyon 'dir shong ba e ma mtshar/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba mchod pa'i legs byas rnams/ /gcig tu spungs kyang khyod kyi ba spu'i khungs/ /re rer mchod pa'i bsod nams ches lhag pas/ /kha tsam brjod la dang bas nyan par gyis/ /'dir lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba mtha' yas pa'i gtsug gi nor bu'i khri la zhabs zung gi rnam par brtsen pa'i chos kyi rgyal po/ rigs pa dang grol ba'i spobs pa mchog gi blo gros kyi dkyil 'khor nye bar rgyas shing / shes bya'i gnas lugs gsal bar gzigs pa'i 'dren byed rab tu mdzes la byang chub sems gnyis kyi rtogs pa'i 'od zer brgya phrag dang ldan pas/ snyigs ma'i dus kyi skye bo ma rig pas ldongs ba rnams la yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi snang ba ches cher bskyed pa'i rta ljang can/ las dang nyon mongs pa'i gdung ba rnam par sel ba'i sman gyi dbang po/

chos kyi rje 'di nyid nges pa kho nar sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rang bzhin rdo rje 'chang chen po yin yang snang ngor bstan tshul gyi rnam par thar pa la don gsum te/ thog mar rigs brgyud khyad par can du 'khrungs shing bstan pa'i sgor zhugs tshul/ bar du thos bsam bsgom gsum gyi rang gzhan la phan pa rgya cher bsgrubs shing bla ma dam pa rnams kyi rjes su bzung tshul/ mthar bstan pa dang sems can la mdzad pa'i phrin las rgyun ma chad par byung ba'i tshul bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ las dang po pa rnams kyi sgrib pa sbyong ba'i thabs mchog tu gyur pa bsnyung bar gnas pa'i lag len gyi cho ga thugs nyams su bzhes shing gzhan la ston pa'i bla ma dam pa zhang ston sgra 'jigs dang / rtsi 'dul ba 'dzin pa/ bla ma chu bzang po la sogs pa du ma dang / mus chen nam mkha'i rnal 'byor/ rin po che shes rab 'bum/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ ma gcig chos sgron la sogs pa grub pa brnyes pa'i skyes bu khyad par can du mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas mus kyi sa cha rta mo gling skya zhes bya bar sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyi dbon po/ dkon mchog legs dang / yum chos skyong rgyal mo gnyis kyi sras su ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas te/ dpal gdong ces bya ba chu mo bya'i lo la sku 'khrungs so/ /de'i dus su sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyi bu gcig po/ chos kyi sgo yin zhes lung bstan mdzad cing gzhan yang phul du byung pa'i lung bstan du ma mdzad ces grags so/ /gzhon nu'i dus kyang chos 'chad pa dang bsgom mdzad pa/ bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzhengs pa sogs kyi rnam 'gyur ma gtogs tha mal gyi byis pa'i spyod pa las 'das pa zhig ste/ dgung lo bcu'i bar du de ltar bskyed bsrings nas/ bcu gcig tshe nges 'byung gi thugs 'dun drag pos kun nas blangs te/

chos kyi rje sems dpa' chen po rat+na dh+wa dzas mkhan po/ kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel bas slob dpon/ chos rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang pas grib tshod/ grub pa'i dbang phyug dkon mchog blo gros pa dang / rje glo rin pa sogs las dge tshul gyi sdom pa yang dag par nod nas bslab par bya ba'i gnas rnams mig gi 'bras bu bzhin blang dor la brtson par mdzad cing / de nas dgung lo nyi shu rtsa brgyad bzhes pa kun ldan gyi lo lcags pho rta la grub chen dkon mchog blo gros pas mkhan po mdzad/ las kyi slob dpon dpal ldan rgyal po dang / gsang ste ston pa'i slob dpon sgrub chen bkra shis rgyas mtshan pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po byams pa chos legs pas grib tshod dang kha skong dge 'dun grangs tshang zhing mtshan nyid mthun pa las u pa sam+pan+na bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes nas/ dge slong gi khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum la dgag sgrub gnang ba'i bslab pa rnams bya ba dang bya ba ma yin pa'i cha tshul bzhin du thugs nyams su bzhes par mdzad do/ /gnyis pa thos bsam bsgom gsum gyis rang gzhan la phan pa rgya cher sgrubs shing bla ma dam pa rnams kyis rjes su bzung tshul ni/ thog mar dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo chos kyi rje dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i drung du/ rje btsun rdo rje bdag med mas dpal stobs kyi mgon po bi rū pa la snyan brgyud bzhis gdams shing skal bar ldan pa'i gdul bya cha gcig la sangs rgyas kyi sar 'khrid pa'i zab lam/ grub pa brnyes pa'i skyes bu rim par byon pa rnams kyi thugs kyi nying khu lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdam ngag nyams myong skye srid lan gsum gyi bar du mnos nas/ rgyu'i dus su smin par byed pa dbang / lam gyi dus su lus kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur/ de dag gi rgyab rten gsung ngag glegs bam gyi dkar chag tu thebs pa phal che ba dang /

lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi byin rlabs/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi bsrung ba'i man ngag thun mong ba/ rdo rje bdag med ma'i dbang bskur ba de dag gi dbang bskur ba'i cho ga'i rnam bzhag ston pa dbang gi chu bo'i bshad pa lag len dang bcas pa/ bde mchog lū hi pa dang dril bu lus dkyil gyi dbang / rdzogs pa'i rim pa yab la sbyar ba'i rtsa dbu ma kha 'byed pa'i man ngag dril bu rim lnga'i khrid/ mngal sgong rdzus skyes sbyong byed lū nag dril gsum du grags pa'i bshad pa/ jo bo nā ro ta pa'i mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs man ngag dang bcas pa gsan/ yang rnal 'byor thabs kyi rgyud la/ gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod rdo rje lha sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi dbang / rdo rje 'jigs byed sa lugs kyi dbang / gshin rje'i gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dbang / de'i rdzogs rim shin tu spros pa med pa'i de kho na nyid kyi man ngag glo bo lo tsā ba'i khrid yig thor bu ba/ spros med mdzes rgyan rnams kyi nyams khrid bshad pa yongs su rdzogs pa gsan/ kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang dang / 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i dbang gnyis sa lugs/ tshe dpag med dze tā ri'i lugs kyi dbang / rdo rje gur gyi mgon po lcam dral gyi rjes gnang / don yod zhags pa dpa' rkyang dang thugs rje chen po skyer sgang lugs kyi rigs gtad/ sgrub thabs bsdus pa brgya rtsar grags pa'i rjes gnang lung dang bcas pa/ slob dpon mi thub zla bas mdzad pa'i he badz+ra'i sgrub thabs yan lag drug pa'i rnam bshad gnad kyi zla zer rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa/ phung po gsum pa'i mdo/ 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sdud pa/ bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam/ thub pa'i dgongs pa gsal ba'i bstan bcos chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas mdzad pa/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po nyid kyi phyogs gcig tu sgrigs pa'i blo sbyong man ngag gi glegs baṃ yongs su rdzogs pa rnams kyi lung gsan zhing /

byang chub sems dpa'i blo sbyong tshul dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'chad kha ba'i man ngag don bdun du bsdus nas ston pa'i nyams khrid/ rten 'brel snying po'i khrid rnams gsan no/ /yang chos kyi rje mtshungs pa med pa'i mkhyen rab kyi yang dag pa'i don phyin ci ma log par gzigs pa'i ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge'i drung du thog mar 'dul ba/ tshad ma rnam 'grel/ phar phyin/ spyod 'jug sdom gsum rab dbye la sogs pa'i gsan sbyongs mthar phyin pa mdzad cing / khyad par du gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras kyi 'khrid tshar gsum/ de dang 'brel pa'i sems bskyed/ rgyu lam gyi dbang / gnyag ma gsal byed dang bcas pa/ rje btsun lha mo bco lnga'i dbang / de'i byin brlabs/ cha lag la lam zab bla ma lam sbas bshad/ brda don gsal ba/ brda chig brgyud/ mgon rkyang gi rjes gnang / spod dmar ma phal cher gyi lung dang bcas pa/ rnam 'joms bir lugs kyi byin rlabs kyang gsan/ gzhan yang kyai rdo rje 'grel pa lugs kyi dbang / mtsho skyes lugs kyi dbang / sam+bu ṭa'i dbang / gur rigs bsdus kyi dbang / rtsa rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa/ rnam bshad dag ldan dang bcas pa/ gur/ gur rgyan dang bcas pa/ sam+bu ṭa gnad kyi gsal byed dang bcas pa gsan/ bde mchog lū hi pa'i dbang / de dang 'brel pa rtsa dbu ma'i khrid/ rje btsun gyi khrid yig dang bcas pa/ dril bu pa'i dbang / de dang 'brel pa dril bu rim lnga'i khrid/ rje btsun chen po'i khrid yig dang bcas pa/ dril bu skor gsum gyi rgya gzhung gi lung / nag po rim bzhi/ rje rang gis mdzad pa'i khrid yig dang bcas pa/ bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang / sangs rgyas thod pa'i dbang / nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin brlabs/ de'i chos skor/ bla ma gong mas mdzad pa'i yig cha lung dang bcas pa rnams kyang gsan/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud/ mu tig phreng ba dang bcas pa gsan/

kun spyod rje btsun gyi 'grel pa dang bcas pa gsan/ gsang 'dus mi bskyod rdo rje'i dbang / de dang 'brel pa'i gsang 'dus rim lnga'i khrid/ gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud/ 'grel pa sgron gsal/ mtha' drug rab gsal dang bcas pa'i bshad pa/ gsang 'dus 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang dang bcas pa/ rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i mngon dkyil gyi lung / sgrol ma lha bcu bdun ma/ a ra pa tsa na lha lnga/ rigs gsum spyi dbang rnams gsan/ sbyong rgyud kyi bshad pa/ rje rang gi ṭī ka'i steng nas gsan/ rjes gnang la dmar po skor gsum/ rnam rgyal/ rnam 'joms/ don zhags/ spyan ras gzigs/ 'jam dbyangs dmar ser/ mi g.yo ba dkar sngo gnyis/ sgrol ma dkar mo/ /'byung po 'dul byed/ u tsa/ rta mgrin lcags ral can/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i 'khrid dang bcas pa/ mgon po'i srung 'khor/ gzhan yang dngos nas brgyud pa'i gcod skor gsum/ 'gro mgon dpal ye bas mdzad pa'i blo sbyong kyang gsan/ lung gi skor la/ gong gi dbang rnams dang 'grel pa'i bla ma gong ma'i yig cha thogs pa dang / rje rang gis mdzad pa'i sngags kyi bka' 'bum phal cher gyi lung sman bla'i mdo chog rnams kyang gsan/ grub chen dkon mchog blo gros pa'i drung du/ lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i khrid tshar drug de dang 'brel pa'i sems bskyed/ rgyu lam gyi dbang / bla ma tshad ma'i skabs su bla ma rgya bod kyi rnam thar/ bla ma so so'i rnam thar/ bla ma'i rnam thar ngo mtshar snang ba/ zhib mo rdo rje/ nyams myong tshad ma'i skabs su gzhung shing chen po bzhi/ rtogs pa bskyed pa'i chos lnga/ gegs sel gyi yi ge bzhi/ dam tshig gi skabs su rtsa ltung 'khrul spong gi bshad pa/ lta ba'i skabs su/ 'khor 'das dbyer med rtsa 'grel/ bskyed rim gyi skabs su/ rnam bshad chen mo'i bshad pa/ bstan bcos tshad ma la/ gzhung bshad sras don ma/ pod dmar ma/ pod nag ma/ lung tshad ma la/

lung 'di nyid dang mdor bsdus te sbyar ba/ lung mtha' dag dang mdor bsdus te sbyar ba/ lung 'di nyid zhib tu sbyar ba la sogs pa'i lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdam ngag tshang ma gsan/ bdag med ma'i dbang / de'i byin rlabs dang bcas pa cha lag zab lam thun mong ba/ thun mong ma yin pa gnyis/ bla ma rin 'byung / bir srungs thun mong ba dang / thun mong ma yin pa gnyis/ sgrub pa lung sbyin pa rnams so so'i yig lung dang bcas pa gsan/ bde mchog so so'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba/ lū hi pa'i mngon rtogs chen mo'i bshad lung rnams kyang gsan/ tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dbang / rjes gnang la mgon po lha brgyad thun mong ma yin pa/ lcam dral thun mong ba/ rnam rgyal gyi rjes gnang rnams kyang gsan/ gcod skor gyi khrid tshang mar gsan/ lung la/ sa skya pa gong ma lnga'i bka' 'bum tshang ma/ rje kun dga' bzang po'i gsung 'bum/ rje sems dpa' chen po'i gsung 'bum/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod/ 'dul ba lung tshang ma/ spyod 'jug thugs rje chen po'i bsgom lung dang bcas pa/ sangs rgyas sgom pa'i tshogs bshad la sogs pa'i lung mang po rnams gsan/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho'i drung du/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ rje kun dga' bzang po'i bstod pa khong pa rang gis mdzad pa gsan/ rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug pa'i drung du/ don zhags gtso rkyang gi rjes gnang / bcu gcig zhal gyi rjes gnang / mi g.yo ba sngon po'i rjes gnang / chu bsrungs rje btsun rtse mo'i lung dang bcas pa gsan/ bdag chen chu mig pa blo gros dbang phyug pa'i drung du/ sems dpa' chen po'i bstod pa bdag chen rang gis mdzad pa/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod/ 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i mngon rtogs kyi lung rnams gsan/ gung ru shes rab bzang po'i drung du/ kyai rdo rje'i bskyed rim kyi bshad pa/ rje sems dpa' chen po'i bstod pa rje rang gis mdzad pa gsan/

chos rje dpal mgon pa'i drung du/ bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang / phyag rgya chen po yi ge med pa'i byin rlabs 'khrid dang bcas pa/ mchod rten drung thob kyi 'khrid/ tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dbang / nam mkha' sgo 'byed kyi dbang / 'byung po 'dul byed kyi rjes gnang rnams gsan/ byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rin chen pa'i drung du/ kyai rdo rje 'grel pa lugs kyi dbang / bde mchog dril bu pa'i dbang / rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang tshang ma/ sbyong dkyil bcu gnyis kyi dbang tshang ma/ rigs gsum spyi dbang / rnam rgyal rnam 'joms kyi rjes gnang dang bcas pa gsan/ chos rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang pa'i drung du/ gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang gsan/ chos rje byams pa chos 'od pa'i drung du/ bsnyung gnas kyi chos skor/ don zhags rgyud chung gi lung dang bcas pa gsan/ grub chen bkra shis rgyal mtshan pa'i drung du/ kyai rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi dbang dang / bde mchog nag po ba'i dbang gsan/ chos rje rdo rje 'chang dkon mchog 'phel ba'i drung du/ rgyu lam gyi dbang / tshe dpag med kyi dbang / mi 'khrugs pa'i dbang / lam zab/ tshar gsum khug pa/ bsam mi khyab kyi byin rlabs/ chos skyong lcam dral gyi rjes gnang / 'jam dbyangs dkar po'i rjes gnang / nag po gzhung drug gi rgya gzhung / sa chen gyis mdzad pa'i nag 'bum/ spros med kyi bir+wa pa'i rgya gzhung / glo bo lo tsā ba'i 'khrid yig thor bu dang bcas pa gsan/ yang dus phyis gshin rje'i gshed dmar po'i rdzogs rim shin tu spros med kyi khrid/ dbu ma sems tsam gnyis kyi sems bskyed/ dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa'i rjes gnang rnams gsan cing thugs kyi sras dam par bzhugs pa yin no/ /chos rje dpal ldan rgyal po'i drung du/ lam dus kyi dbang / bdag med ma'i dbang byin rlabs dang bcas pa/ tshe dpag med kyi dbang / bde mchog dkar po'i byin rlabs 'khrid dang bcas pa/

lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdam ngag yi ge med pa dang mchod rten drung thob ma gtogs pa'i lam skor phyi ma drug gi 'khrid/ dur khrod bdag po'i rjes gnang / las mgon 'khor rkyang gi rjes gnang / mgon po'i man ngag rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi pa'i khrid la sogs pa mgon po'i skor zab la mang po/ bde mchog lū nag gi bskyed rim gyi bshad pa/ dpal mngon par rtogs pa'i lung / gnyan phul byung pas mdzad pa'i 'bru 'bum gyi lung dang bcas pa gsan/ ka bcu pa rdor rgyal ba'i drung du/ tshe dpag tu med pa'i dbang bskur ba gsan/ sngags 'chang chen po rin chen rnam rgyal ba'i drung du/ rdo rje 'jigs byed ro langs brgyad skor gyi dbang / bcu gsum ma'i dbang / las gshin bcu gsum ma'i rjes gnang / dug dbang rma bya rgyas pa/ rwa pod kyi lung / las gshin gyi mchod chog gnyis kyi lung / gur mgon bcu gnyis ma'i rjes gnang / gdong bzhi pa'i rjes gnang / tshe 'phel dkar po'i lung / chos skyong che ba'i yig cha rnams kyi lung / tshe dpag med grub rgyal ma'i dbang / tshe khrid dang bcas pa gsan/ karma zhwa nag pa chos grags rgya mtsho'i drung du/ sku gsum ngo sprod kyi khrid/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ spyan ras gzigs kyi sgom lung rnams gsan/ bla ma mgon po bzang po pa'i drung du/ chos skyong gdong bzhi pa'i rjes gnang / gdong gnyan can gyi rjes gnang / las mgon gyi rjes gnang / yig cha'i lung 'ga' zhig dang bcas pa gsan/ sngags 'chang mchog rgyal ba'i drung du/ lha mo dur sol ma'i rjes gnang gsan/ bla ma nam mkha' bsod nams pa'i drung du/ rnying ma ba'i tshe rta sgrags ma'i dbang gsan/ de ltar gsan pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol du son pa de dag kyang bsam pa las byung pa'i shes rab dri ma med pas legs par bskyangs te byin rlabs kyi rgyun ma nyams par sgom bsgrub mthar phyin par mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ dus rgyun du/

dpal sa skya pa rnams kyi thug dam nyams bzhes rje btsun dges mdzad rdo rje'i phyi nang gi dkyil 'khor mngon par gsal btab nas dbang bzhi'i chu bo rgyas par len pa/ de dang 'brel par lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi bsrung ba'i man ngag thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa/ bla ma nā ro ta pa'i mkha' spyod kyi man ngag rnams thun bzhir ma chag pa mdzad cing / 'khor lo bde mchog slob dpon nag po spyod pa'i lugs dang / rdo rje dril bu pa'i lugs kyi bsgom bzlas/ gshin rje'i gshed dmar po lha lnga/ rdo rje 'jigs byed rwa lo tsā ba'i lugs/ rje btsun bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i phyi nang gi dkyil 'khor sgrags pa/ lam dus kyi dbang dang bcas pa/ ngan song sbyong ba'i bdag skyed/ 'chi bdag 'joms pa/ tshe dpag med lha dgu dang / dpa' bo gcig pa/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs a ra pa tsa/ rnam rgyal 'joms/ 'chi ba bslu ba'i sgrol ma/ phyag na rdo rje u tsar+ya/ 'byung po 'dul byed rdo rje gur nas gsungs pa/ thugs rje chen po'i yi ge drug pa la sogs pa'i bzlas bsgom du ma dang / dpal gur gyi mgon po'i bsrung bzlog phyi nang gsang ba'i man ngag chos spyod gtor ma'i rim pa mtha' yas pa mdzad la/ khyad par bcom ldan 'das dges pa rdo rje'i gzhi dus kyi bsnyen pa kha skong gi sbyin sreg dang bcas pa lan gnyis/ 'khor lo bde mchog ma la skyes ltar bskyed pa'i bsnyen bsgrub/ gshed dmar lha lnga 'jigs byed rwa lugs/ kun rig 'chi 'joms/ tshe dpag med rig byed ma/ seng ge sgra/ he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa rnams la grangs bsnyen tshang pa/ gur gyi mgon po'i phyi nang gi bsnyen bsgrub rnams byin gyis brlab pa'i mtshan ma brnyes kyi bar du mdzad pa la brten nas bla ma dang lhag pa'i lhas rjes su gzung zhing lung bstan pa'i tshul mdo tsam brjod na/ rje btsun sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dgung lo don bdun bzhes pa'i dus tshem zhig byon pa 'di la gnang nas nga'i lo 'di tsam thub ces lung bstan cing de rjes tshem de bor nas rtse gcig pa'i thugs kyi gsol ba btab pas/

rnam rgyal gyi gzungs nyi shu rtsa lnga re bzlas pas 'ong gsungs ba mnal lam du byung ba'i tshul mdzad pa/ yang skabs zhig tu gling skya'i ri la khri gcig gi steng na sems dpa' chen po gzi mdangs dang bcas pa la 'khor mang pos bskor nas 'phur ba'i snang ba byung zhing / sems dpa' chen po la mkha' 'gro mas phul ba'i thub pa'i gser sku grub chen dkon mchog blo gros pa la gnang ba de/ grub chen rang gi grwa pa gzhan zhig la gnang nas zhag kha yar song tsam na de khyod la byin pas mi yong bar 'dug khong la gtad dgos pa yod ces gsung nas chos kyi rje 'di nyid la gnang ngo / /yang dus gcig gi tshe gsung ngag snga ma rang gsung pa'i dgongs pa yod mtshams/ rje grub chen dkon blo'i gsung gis da res lam 'bras ma gsung khyed kyi chos gos de nga'i rtsar yang yang skyel du byung ba rmis bas thugs dam zhig mdzod gsung pa la brten nas/ mgon po'i bsnyen pa mdzad pas/ khri chen po gcig la bzhugs nas snam sbyar mang po sku la bzhes pa'i mnal lam byung ba grub chen la zhus pas shin tu legs pa'i lung bstan mdzad la/ khyad par rnyigs dus kyi rdo rje 'chang gnyis pa rje btsun rat+na wādha'i zhal snga nas kyi bka' lung gtso bor phebs pa dang / chos rje rnam rgyal bas sman gyi sbyin bdag mdzad nas/ yos lo sa ga zla ba'i nyer gsum gyi nyin nas gnam gang gi bar la/ rje nyid kyi phyag phyir chos rje tshul khrims bzang po ba la sogs pa dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa drug gis rgyud sde dri ma med pa rnams las 'byung ba ltar 'chi ba med pa'i ril bu cho ga bzhin bsgrub par mdzad pa'i dus/ mi'i spyod yul las 'das pa'i dri bzang po dang rol mo'i sgra ches phul du byung ba kun gyis tshor ba dang / sku drung nyid du mthu stobs dbang phyug gis byin gyis brlabs pa'i ltas khyad par can byung zhing 'khor du gnas pa kun la yang grub pa'i rdzas dang shing tog ster ba sogs ngo mtshar ba rmad du byung /

yang snga gong rje sems dpa' chen po la bla ma brgyud pas bskor ba'i sku brnyan zhig la sang rab gnas mdzad pa'i de nub mnal lam du rje btsun nyid la mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa/ rje grub chen rat+na ma ti/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge/ chos rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang po rnams kyi bkra shis brjod cing rab tu gnas par mdzad pa dang / dus gzhan zhig na rje mus chen gyis khyed la byin gsung nas gnang ba yin gsung zhing grub chen gyi thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba cig gnang ba yongs su rdzogs par gsol ba'i lhag ma yang chu dang bsres nas bzhes pa'i mnal lam byung ba dang / yang skabs cig tu rje mus chen gyi sgrub gnas/ g.ya' ma ting dkrol gyi phug tu phebs nas/ thugs dam cung zad mdzad cing / phyag phyi ba rnams phyir song ba'i tshe/ gzigs snang la rje nyid la snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhis bskor ba'i dngos grub kyi mtshan ma byung zhes bsgrub pa ba sangs rgyas dpal la bkas gnang ba sogs mdor na bla ma gong du smos pa de rnams kyis rtse gcig par dgongs shing yi dam gyi lha rnams dang gnyis su med pa'i chos bsrung rnams bran ltar 'khol ba'i ting nge 'dzin mu mtha' med pa la thugs mnyam par gzhag pa'i ngang nas skye dgu grangs med pa smin cing grol bar mdzad do/ /gsum pa bstan pa dang sems can la mdzad pa'i phrin las rgyun mi 'chad pa byung ba'i tshul ni/ legs bshad rtsom na sdeb sbyor gtso bor mi mdzad cing / phan pa nyid lhur len pa'i sgo nas yang dag pa'i lam la nges pa kho nar sbyor bar mdzad pa'i bstan bcos kyi rnam grangs ni/ gtsug tor/ rnam par rgyal ma'i bla ma brgyud pa dang / bcom ldan 'das ma nyid la bstod pa'i rab tu byed pa/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge'i rnam thar/ grub chen dkon mchog blo gros pa'i rnam thar rtsa 'grel/ rje btsun dkon mchog 'phel ba'i rnam thar/ lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi rnam bshad/

gzhung ji lta ba bzhin bkri ba'i 'khrid kyi gsung sgros/ rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig rnams kyi bshad pa mdo tsam/ 'khor lo bde mchog nag po pa'i mngon rtogs/ lū hi pa'i bskyed rim gyi bshad pa/ de'i sgrub mchod kyi zur 'debs/ bde mchog dkar po'i tshe sgrub kyi yi ge/ gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags lugs kyi cho ga'i zur 'debs/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sgrub dkyil gyi gsal byed dang / de'i bkra shis/ mgon po lcam dral gyi rjes gnang gi yi ge/ de'i nang sgrub 'jam rtsub kyi gsal byed gnyis/ 'khor rkyang gi rjes gnang byed tshul sogs man ngag thor bu tshan gcig dpal dur sol lha mo'i rjes gnang / gtor chog bskang gso'i yi ge/ dur khrod bdag po'i rjes gnang gtor chog chom rkun bcing ba'i las tshogs/ sa lugs kyi 'chi bdag 'joms pa dang / tshe dpag med lha dgu ma'i dbang chog re re/ ngan song sbyong rgyud brtag pa phyi ma nas bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor bcu gcig gi dbang bskur ba'i zur 'debs rtsa skya pa'i lugs/ sgrol ma dkar mo 'chi ba bslu ba'i sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang byed tshul/ seng ge sgra'i mngon rtogs/ 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa dang / 'byung po 'dul byed kyi rjes gnang byed tshul/ don yod zhags pa'i gzungs sgrub kyi lag len dang / gnod sbyin pho mo'i 'khor lo sgrub yig e waṃ nas 'bul sdud pa la gnang ba'i bka' shog tshe dpag med grub rgyal ma'i byin rlabs zur 'debs/ gcod gdan thog gcig tu nyams su blang tshul gyi man ngag lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi ngag 'don/ kyai rdo rje'i rtsa sngags kyi bshad pa/ bdud rtsi ril bu sgrub pa'i phyag len sogs dri ma med pa'i ring lugs yun ring du gnas pa'i thabs la mngon par sbyor ba ches phul du byung ba nyid yin la/ gsung rab kyi don dang don ma yin pa rnam par dpyod pa'i mkhyen rab kyang gzhan gyis 'gran par mi bzod pa'i rigs pa mchog gis skal bar ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams nges par legs pa'i lam la sbyor bar mdzad cing lta ba dang grub pa'i mtha' yang rang gi dam bcas pa'i kho na mchog tu rloms nas gzhan dag la ches cher smod pa rnams kyang bdag nyid chen po 'di'i thabs la mkhas pa'i sgo nas rnam par grol ba'i lam du 'jug par mdzad do/

/dam pa'i chos 'chad pa dbyangs can gyi mgrin pa ltar snyan pas kha ba'i khrod dge legs su mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ dgung lo sum cu rtsa gnyis nas brtsams te/ gsung ngag rin po che tshar bzhi bcu tsam dang / gzhan yang 'khor lo sdom pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi man ngag gshin rje'i gshed skor/ kṛ ya sa muts+tsha'i dbang / sa skya bka' 'bum la sogs pa'i lung gi tshogs grangs las 'das pa mdzad cing / khyad par nā len+d+ra dang / e waṃ chos ldan gyi khri thog tu phebs nas skal ba dang 'tshams par/ bsnyen gnas dge bsnyen dge tshul dge slong sogs so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang / brgyud pa'i bka' srol gnyis las byung ba'i sems bskyed pa'i cho ga dang / gsang sngags kyi dbang rjes gnang lung man ngag grangs med pas skye bo 'bum phrag du ma smin par mdzad pas/ bstan pa 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po byung ba yang 'bras yul chos rje 'jam dbyangs kun dga' chos bzang / chos rje nor bu ba/ gser mdog can gyi gdan sa chos rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan pa/ thub bstan yangs pa can gyi gdan sa pa chos rje thugs rje dpal bzang / gsang ne'u thog gi gling stod smad kyi gdan sa pa/ e waṃ chos ldan gyi gdan sa pa chos rje lha mchog seng ge ba dang / rting skyes phyogs su chos rje kun dga' mchog ldan pa sku mched/ bdag chen don grub rgyal mtshan pa khu dbon/ mnga' ris bzhi sde ba'i mkhan po rnam rgyal ba la sogs mtha' yas pa byung cing / dpal sa skya dang nye bar bshad nyan gyi grwa dar rgyas su mdzad pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen dngos grub dpal 'bar ba dang / nges cag spun la'ang zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo grangs med pa stsol bar mdzad pa/ de dag kyang slob ma dang nying slob bgrang ba las 'das pas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyin mor byed pa'i 'od ltar ches dar zhing rgyas par gyur to/ /e ma gser mngal gtsug tor gyi/

/nor bu'i khri la nyer 'khod nas/ /sa gsum phan bder mdzad pa'i mgon/ /zhabs kyi chu skyes brtan gyur cig /yid 'phrog lang tshogs ra pa'i dpal yon can/ /legs bshad mgrin pa'i rdza rnga phyogs bcur sgrogs/ /rdo rje'i thugs las nam yang g.yo med par/ /rin chen chos kyi khri la rtag bzhugs mdzod/ /dpal ldan 'dam skyes dbang po'i khri la rab gnas bsod nams brgya pa'i mtshan can shākya seng ge la/ /nges par legs pa'i lam mchog srid dang mya ngan 'das pa'i dga' ba kun nas 'phrog byed bden pa'i gsung / /rnam dag khrims dang ldan zhing thos pa rgya mtsho'i ngogs gnas dge 'dun bden pa'i byin rlabs dpag yas dang / /'chi med rgyal ba ral par 'dzin dang rdo rje rnon po'i dge bas yun du gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces shis pa brjod pa dang bcas pa'i rnam par thar pa 'di 'bri ba'i dus nam gyi tshe yin snyam na/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyis stong lnga brgya na bod kyi yul du dam pa'i chos 'byung la de nas lo'i tshogs rab tu mang po 'das pa shing pho khyi'i lo la/ 'khon ston dkon mchog rgyal po 'khrungs shing des dgung lo bzhi bcu bzhes pa chu mo glang gi lo la/ dpal sa skya 'gram gting pa de nas lo bcu dgu 'das pa chu pho spre'u'i lo la bla ma sa skya pa kun dga' snying po 'khrungs so/ /de nas dgung lo lnga bcu bzhes pa chu pho khyi lo slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo 'khrungs nas dgung lo zhe gcig bzhes pa chu pho stag gi lo dbo'i zla ba'i nyer drug la sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta 'khrungs/ de nas lo lnga bcu nga gsum 'das pa na bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal 'khrungs so/ /de yi lnga bcu nga gcig bzhes pa chu pho byi ba'i lo la 'gro ba'i mgon po bsod nams rgyal mtshan 'khrungs nas so brgyad song ba lcags pho stag la/ g.yag ston sangs rgyas dpal 'khrungs shing /

de nas lo so gnyis song pa na chu pho khyi'i lo rnga chen zhes pa la/ rdo rje 'chang ā nan+da bha dra bltams nas dgung lo nyer dgu bzhes pa lcags mo yos la mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje 'khrungs/ des dgung lo bcu dgu bzhes shing / rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid kyis dgung lo zhe brgyad bzhes pa/ sa mo bya'i lo zhi ba ces pa la e waṃ chos ldan btab po/ de nas drug cu skor cig 'das pa/ sa mo bya'i lo la/ chos rje dpal ldan rdo rje'i rnam thar bdud rtsi'i 'od can dad ldan bde 'byung gi gtsug na rnam par mdzes pa ces bya ba/ bdag gi bla ma rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhyen pa'i spyan gyis gzigs pa/ ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta kīrti badz+ra'i zhabs kyis mdzad la/ 'di'i bar gyi lo grangs rnams ni rnam par thar pa de nyid las byung ba bzhin bris pa yin/ de nas lo nyer dgu song ba dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i byed rtsis me mkha' rgya mtsho dag pa'i lo gzhir bzhag nas/ lo bdun brgya bcu gcig lon zhing / thub pa'i dbang po dgongs pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan nas/ lo sum stong drug brgya zhe dgu 'das pa me mo glang lo dbang po zhes bya ba/ rje btsun bla ma bud+dha rat+na'i zhabs kyi dgung lo lnga ye lhag pa'i bcu phrag drug bzhes pa na/ rnam par thar pa 'di nyid dpal sa skya yon tan rin po che'i 'byung gnas su brtsams so/ /rab 'byams zhing gi rgyal ba du mas kyang / /rab tu mchod cing bsngags par 'os pa nyid/ /rab dang gus pa'i sems kyi gsol btab nas/ /rab mchog 'bras bu tshe 'dir rtsol bar 'gyur/ /dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas kun gyi lam/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug du mas bsten pa'i gnas/ /rdo rje theg pa'i nye lam mthar thug pa/ /bla ma mchog las gzhan na yod min pas/ /rtse gcig dad dang gus pa'i sems 'chang zhing / /rnam thar bsam na 'di phyi'i dge legs kun/ /'bad med 'byung zhing zad pa med pa'i phyir/

/dge legs rin chen gter zhes bya ba yin/ /de lta'i dge ba dri med gang thob des/ /'gro kun rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang dang / /myur du phrad nas khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon/ /dges pa'i thugs kyis rjes su 'dzin gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni rje btsun de nyid las gdams pa rgya mtsho'i bka' drin nye bar nos pa shrī bhū mi paṇ+ḍu shākya bhik+ṣu lo tsā ba mañdzu gho ṣā nan+da pu ṇ+ya kīrti dh+wa dza shrī bha dras/ dbang po'i lo sgron gyi zla ba'i rdzogs pa'i tshes la dpal sa skyar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong / sid+dha singha na li khi ṭaṃ/ /e waṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sa lo chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen gyi rnam thar/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
